_about: Which regions the world audit holds to 100 % green (scripts/art/world_audit.py --gate, npm run check:world-audit; docs/vision/world-audit.md). A region is 'old' until its owner rebuilds it to the standard; mark it 'rebuilt' in the PR that does, and the gate fails on any cell of it that is not green. 'exempt' lists findings that are right as drawn: {"region", "check", "rect": [x, y, w, h] in region px, "why"}.
